First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursday No-Drop Ride (Roanoke Mountain Adventures) group ride

Thursday No-Drop Ride (Roanoke Mountain Adventures) is a road and gravel group ride in Roanoke, VA. It rolls every Thursday at 5:30 pm from Roanoke Mountain Adventures, covered patio.

A no-drop, two-hour ride for road and gravel riders. The group uses several routes up to the Mill Mountain Star and descends back to the shop for a post-ride drink (bring your own).
